text:
alex_ae: Hey team — kicking off the MistralBank POC thread. Need to collect SSO metadata, SCIM mapping, expected user/group volume, and surface any enterprise blockers (security questionnaire, domain controls). Also customer asked for Dedicated pricing delta vs hosted. :wave:
mistral_admin: thanks Alex — attaching SAML metadata now (will post link in a sec). We have ~12k users, ~450 groups, mostly email-based logins. SCIM should be the source of truth.
alex_ae: got it. @jean_engineer can you confirm SCIM capabilities (delta vs full, rate limits, group support)?
jean_engineer: SCIM supports both full and incremental (delta) syncs. Default throttle is 10 req/s; on Dedicated we can increase to 50-100 req/s depending on SLA. Groups supported with member lists and nested groups are flattened. Attributes we expect: email -> userName, externalId -> id, name.givenName/familyName, active.
maria_sec: Security checklist: customer asked for SOC2 Type II, DPA, penetration test summary, and KMS/HSM options. We have SOC2 and DPA template. For hosted, we provide provider-managed keys and encryption at rest; for Private (VPC/on-prem) we can integrate customer KMS/HSM and bring-your-own-key.
mistral_admin: good — please drop links to SOC2 and DPA and confirm audit log retention for Hosted vs Dedicated. Also need answers on domain verification for tenant locking and forced SSO.
alex_ae: @maria_sec I'll need the links and a short answer on logs/retention. For domain proofing we support DNS TXT or email domain verification. Tenant lock (enforce only verified domains) is available on Dedicated and Private; for Hosted we can enforce with additional contract terms.
maria_sec: links: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2, https://redwood.example.com/security/dpa. Audit logs: Hosted = 30 days default, add-on for 1 year; Dedicated/Private = configurable (customer-controlled retention).
devon_sre: network note — for Private deployments we require either VPC peering or private link and specific egress ports. If they choose Dedicated but hosted, we need to size GPU pool (minimum baseline) and know traffic pattern.
mistral_admin: sizing question — what commit gets us Dedicated pricing? Also what's the usual onboarding lead time?
sam_se: Dedicated pricing starts at reserved capacity (typically 4x A100-equivalent baseline); pricing varies by region and commitment term. Ballpark starting point is in the mid 10s of thousands/month; exact quote depends on model profile and burst needs. Onboarding for Dedicated is ~4–6 weeks, Private on-prem longer (~8–12 weeks).
alex_ae: great. Back to SCIM — @mistral_admin can you confirm whether groups include entitlements/roles, and whether they'll want delegated admin via SCIM?
mistral_admin: Yes, groups carry role names and entitlement flags. We want delegated admin for tiered support.
jean_engineer: we can map group.role -> role_id and push custom roles via the API. Example SCIM user payload we accept:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "alice@example.com",
  "externalId": "1234",
  "name": {"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Smith"},
  "active": true
}
```
alex_ae: quick checklist for the sales playbook: 1) Get SAML metadata (idp metadata XML) 2) SCIM attribute map + sample user/group JSON 3) User counts + peak concurrency estimates 4) Security questionnaire returned 5) Decision: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private 6) Timeline for provisioning
mistral_admin: I'll send metadata and a filled security questionnaire by EOD. One blocker: legal wants clarity on data residency and whether logs ever leave region.
maria_sec: data residency: we deploy workloads in the chosen region; logs for Hosted are stored in-region when region option selected. For cross-region failover we can replicate with customer consent; include in DPA.
idp_bot: Incident view: no open incidents in targeted region us-west-2.
alex_ae: thanks everyone — I'll collect artifacts and loop in Solutions for a short technical call tomorrow. Action items: @mistral_admin upload metadata + questionnaire, @jean_engineer prepare a short doc on SCIM rate bump process, @maria_sec share DPA summary, @sam_se draft preliminary Dedicated quote. :thumbsup:
